runtimePin.scope: All 203 regular files in the supplied archify/ snapshot; content hashes, not vendored content. No dependencies installed.

modifications: On-demand only; no proactive pages, installation or global rules.
Standard-library adapter; explicit external runtime and approved output root; plan before explicit execution.
Native JSON diagram delivery plus strict provenance check only; no finalize, browser, export, explainer Markdown or arbitrary CLI forwarding.
Update checks always disabled via upstream ARCHIFY_UPDATE_CHECK_DISABLED=1; no network-sandbox claim.
Generic semantic icons only; third-party brands and external resource URLs refused.
Tests use a generated mock process, not the real renderer or browser.
